dict.string: Sticks uses Face ID to sign you in without retyping your password.
Sticks uses your location to show live GPS distances to the green while you play, and to keep those distances live on your lock screen and Apple Watch during a round.
Sticks connects to Health so it can start the Sticks app on your Apple Watch when a round begins — the watch records that round as a golf workout.
Sticks saves each round to Health as a golf workout from your Apple Watch, so it counts toward your Activity rings.
